clue.text: Simple vehicle cut sharp moves

indicators.note: the letters of 'cut sharp' are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: A knife-sharpening tip: making a sharp cut with deft moves.
explanation.definitionFit: A hand-pushed cart is about as basic as a wheeled conveyance gets, the barrow of street traders.

clue.text: Guided holy man from Sodom before heartless end

indicators.note: the man from Sodom comes ahead of the next piece

parts.note: PI is short for pious, so holy
Lot is the Biblical man who fled Sodom

indicators.note: a heartless word loses its middle letter, so 'end' drops its centre

explanation.surface: A Biblical tale of a holy man led out of Sodom before a grim finish.
explanation.definitionFit: To pilot is to steer or lead, so the past tense matches being guided.

clue.text: Throttle holy man with right point of view

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for saint
an angle is a perspective or slant on something

explanation.surface: A saint who insists he is right about his point of view, and someone wants to choke him.
explanation.definitionFit: Both verbs mean to choke someone by squeezing the throat.

clue.text: Designer is part of circle to beat English court

parts.note: an arc is a section of a circle's circumference
to hit is to beat or strike

explanation.surface: A designer's portfolio describing a curved form beating an English court.
explanation.definitionFit: An architect is the person who designs buildings.

clue.text: Article appearing in Echo after Thursday

indicators.note: the Echo letter is placed following the weekday abbreviation

parts.note: Echo is E in ... NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A newspaper item in the Echo, published after Thursday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Echo' looks like a newspaper title, but it is the radio code word for E.
explanation.definitionFit: The definite article is the grammatical article in English.

clue.text: General sense that a lot of people studying science end with!

definitions.meaning: the overall meaning or essence of something

definitions.text: that a lot of people studying science end with!
definitions.meaning: scientists such as biologists and geologists all finish with these four letters

explanation.surface: A general idea that many science students end up with.
explanation.walkthrough: The second half reads as students' conclusions, but literally points to the last letters of words like geologist.
explanation.definitionFit: The essence or main point of something is its overall drift.

clue.text: Maybe Sam Spade sticks with another tool for gardener

parts.note: gums means glues or sticks
a hoe is a gardening tool for weeding

explanation.surface: A garden scene with Sam Spade sticking with a spade, then another tool.
explanation.walkthrough: Sam Spade is Dashiell Hammett's private eye; his surname makes 'another tool' natural in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Sam Spade is an example of a private detective, slang for which is this American word.

clue.text: Refinery melts ore, somehow extracting oxygen

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters are rearranged in an unspecified way
extracting says a letter is pulled out of the mixed letters

parts.note: O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A refinery melts ore in some fashion while pulling oxygen out of it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' rearranges MELTS ORE and 'extracting' removes the O for oxygen from that pool.
explanation.definitionFit: A smelter is a plant where ore is heated to refine metal from it.

clue.text: Bird's carefree frolic

definitions.meaning: a bit of fun or a prank done for amusement

explanation.surface: A bird enjoying a happy-go-lucky romp.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a singing bird and a light-hearted escapade.

clue.text: Ma, create fantastic meal with scones

indicators.note: fantastic suggests the letters are made wild and rearranged

explanation.surface: Telling Mum to make a fabulous spread of scones.
explanation.walkthrough: A cream tea is a British afternoon snack of tea with scones, jam and clotted cream.
explanation.definitionFit: This afternoon treat is defined by scones served with cream and jam.

clue.text: Ecstasy widespread after a number arriving at Spanish island

indicators.note: the number goes ahead of the Ecstasy pieces

parts.note: ten is a number
E is slang for the drug ecstasy
rife means common or widespread

explanation.surface: Drug use rampant among a group arriving at a Spanish holiday island.
explanation.definitionFit: Tenerife is the largest of the Canary Islands, which belong to Spain.

clue.text: Endless series of steps to get to the next level

definitions.text: Endless series of steps to get to the next level

parts.words: Endless series of steps to get to the next level
parts.note: a moving staircase has steps that loop round forever, carrying people up a floor

explanation.surface: Sounds like an unending career ladder or a game's progression.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endless' reads as tedious, but the moving staircase's steps really do circulate without end.
explanation.definitionFit: A moving staircase lifts people between floors on a continuous belt of steps.

clue.text: Bravo for flamenco in East End pit?

indicators.note: Cockneys from London's East End traditionally drop the H at the start of words

parts.note: a hole is a pit

explanation.surface: Applause for flamenco dancers performing in an East End mine.
explanation.walkthrough: The East End is the working-class area of East London, whose Cockney accent drops initial H.
explanation.definitionFit: Olé is the Spanish shout of approval heard at flamenco shows and bullfights.

clue.text: Vegetative lump partly turned to rise, unsupported

indicators.note: the stretch picked out is read backwards
only part of the phrase 'Vegetative lump' is used

explanation.surface: A vegetable lump that has partly turned and now rises with nothing beneath it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partly' picks ETATIVEL from 'Vegetative lump' and 'turned' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: To levitate is to float upwards with no visible means of support.

clue.text: Get bigger Detective Inspector in front of deceased

indicators.note: the detective's letters come before the next piece

parts.note: the late means dead or deceased

explanation.surface: A police officer growing in stature before a dead body.
explanation.definitionFit: To dilate is to widen or expand, as pupils do.

clue.text: Perhaps Shakespeare under the weather provides Iago's motivation?

parts.note: under the weather means ill
Will is Shakespeare's first name, an example of a Will

explanation.surface: The Bard, feeling poorly, supplies the reason behind a villain's scheming.
explanation.walkthrough: Iago is the villain of Shakespeare's Othello; the question mark marks his spite as one instance.
explanation.definitionFit: Malice or hostility is what drives Iago to destroy Othello.

clue.text: Iago's end almost excited worry

indicators.note: excited suggests the letters are stirred up into a new order
almost means the last letter of 'end' is cut

explanation.surface: Iago's near-finish stirs up anxiety.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims 'end' to EN; 'excited' rearranges IAGOS and EN.
explanation.definitionFit: To agonise is to fret or torment oneself over something.

clue.text: Shouts encouragement in board game with centre hidden

indicators.note: the middle two letters of the game's name are covered up and taken away

parts.note: checkers is the American name for draughts

explanation.surface: Supporters shouting at a board game whose middle is obscured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with centre hidden' removes CK, the middle pair of the eight letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheers is a verb for shouting support at someone.

clue.text: Supervisor to attract aliens northward

indicators.note: in a down answer, going northward means reading from bottom to top

parts.note: to draw is to attract
ETs are extraterrestrials

explanation.surface: A supervisor lures aliens up north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'northward' reverses DRAWETS in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A steward oversees or manages an estate, event or household.

clue.text: Support stage for Journey

definitions.meaning: a limb or post holding something up, as on a table

explanation.surface: Backing a phase of a tour by the rock band Journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A table's prop and one section of a trip share the same short word.

clue.text: Air simple kind of shirt covering jeans

indicators.note: the shirt wraps around the jeans

parts.note: a tee is a T-shirt
Levi's is a brand of jeans

explanation.surface: Airing your wardrobe: a plain shirt worn over denim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Air' looks like breathing or freshening, but means broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: To air a programme is to broadcast it on television.

clue.text: Reversing cap, one polite chap is hard-working

indicators.note: the word for a cap is turned back to front

parts.note: a lid is a cap or cover
I is the Roman numeral for one
a gent is a gentleman

explanation.surface: A well-mannered man turning his cap round shows he is industrious.
explanation.definitionFit: Being diligent means being careful and industrious in your work.

clue.text: Decline eastern bishop twice

indicators.note: twice means the bishop letter appears two times

parts.note: B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: An eastern bishop's decline, stated twice over.
explanation.definitionFit: To ebb is to recede or diminish, like the outgoing tide.

clue.text: Grand, in the style of festive event

parts.note: à la means in the manner of

explanation.surface: A grand party done in a particular manner.
explanation.definitionFit: A gala is a celebratory occasion or special entertainment.

clue.text: Tory puffed out air in speech

indicators.note: in speech means the word sounds the same when spoken

parts.note: blew is the past tense of blow, to puff out air

explanation.surface: A Conservative politician blowing hot air while speechmaking.
explanation.walkthrough: Blue is the colour of Britain's Conservative Party, so a Conservative is a blue.
explanation.definitionFit: A British Conservative is called a blue after the party colour.

clue.text: European among bidders wasted chicken feed, perhaps

indicators.note: the European letter goes in the middle of the other letters
wasted suggests the letters are wrecked and jumbled

explanation.surface: A European among drunken auction bidders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wasted' rearranges BIDDERS and 'among' puts E inside the result.
explanation.definitionFit: Grain for chickens is one example of food for birds.
